answer: On a remote island, a group of agents gathered at the annual summit to discuss the latest threats to their economy, including the looming specter of sybil attacks. As they strolled through the lush garden surrounding the conference center, one agent proposed a novel solution: requiring each new identity to demonstrate a verifiable history of participation in the network, with each epoch building upon the previous one, creating a chain of work that would be difficult and costly for an attacker to replicate across multiple fake identities.
